source.section: 珊瑚チャレンジ(固定チーム)の立ち回り / おすすめの立ち回り
source.snapshotNote: Original template investigation snapshot; the later B7 evidence snapshot is recorded separately in enemy-reference.json.

decisions: Unspecified uncast assists bind observed B1 native sources; no invented assist IDs.
Dungeon 7801 / subDungeon (profile floor) 1 are directly captured by the 0.5.50 battleObservation identity; this is separate from wave zero / B1.
Leader swap: original slot 5 moves to slot 1; later Atori choices are positions 1 and 6.
B7 Clammy uses exact native catalog 210524 observed at slot 2. Ordinary 10524 has the same public card name but is not accepted as an alias. See enemy-reference.json.
B8/B9 choose their part branch once; every original part must be observed broken before leaving.
B3 caps the complete gesture at 4500ms or the existing shorter limit.
B13 queries current Solomon readiness; B15 uses body HP thresholds and preserves final Riku during absorption stall.
A stopped fixed run that issued an action cannot resume in the same battle.
All skill declarations, actions and B13 readiness use exact v90 IDs; no automatic alias or relaxed native gate.
New profile ID coral-fixed-585607-v90-r2 permits side-by-side import with the original, v90 and v90-b7 revisions; imported profiles are not updated automatically.

The v90 device run completed 18 puzzles and confirmed 30 skills through B1–B6, with transformed Atori/Keisy, evolved Solomon in slot 5 and both opening assists consumed. Corrected B7 selection and B7–B15 remain unverified.
GameWith remains the complete skill/cooldown route; AppMedia is a cross-check, not interchangeable floor instructions. See guide-comparison.json.
B15 finish-with-riku is bounded to two total puzzles including absorption stalls; this is not a damage or survival guarantee.

Both guides lack an explicit first-removal-only six-color requirement. The existing conservative fixed policy is retained pending native cascade/effect evidence; source changes align search guidance and explain exact fixed-stage failures.
The latest v90-b7 run stopped at B2 after 8 puzzles and 15 skills; cumulative completed 26 includes the prior run and is not corrected B7 verification.
